'''2024 Online Retro Event for Charity''' was the Players Committee [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]] charity event on GEMP, 11 May – 6 July 2024. [[Patrick Lima]] finished 1st among the published lists.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-07-online-retro-event-for-charity-classic-no-v/ 2024-07 Online Retro Event for Charity – Classic No-V], starwarsccg.org. Snapshot: . Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014154847/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-07-online-retro-event-for-charity-classic-no-v.html Internet Archive, 14 October 2026]</ref>

* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]<ref name="pc" /><ref name="t84638">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84638 DECKLISTS: Top 8 for 2024 Annual Online Retro Event for Charity (Classic No-V)], forum.starwarsccg.org. Snapshot: . Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014154925/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84638.html Internet Archive, 14 October 2026]</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 11 May – 6 July 2024

== Playoff schedule ==
Streamed elimination matches announced on the Players Committee Slack included:<ref name="slack-retro24-playoffs">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Jared Napolitano]] (JaredNap), [[James Martin]] (solidsnck), and [[Dan Tartaglione]] (DTartagOne), 23 June – 6 July 2024 (#1906, #1908, #1910–#1911, #1914).</ref>
* '''Quarterfinals (23 June 2024):''' [[Jonny Chu]] vs. [[David Garcia]]
* '''Quarterfinals (24 June 2024):''' [[Joe Horbey]] vs. [[Michael Pistone|Michael Pistone]]
* '''Semifinals (30 June 2024):''' #2 [[Brad Kippel]] vs. #8 [[Patrick Lima]]
* '''Semifinals (1 July 2024):''' #3 [[Jonny Chu|Jonathan Chu]] vs. #7 [[Michael Pistone|Michael Pistone]]
* '''Finals (6 July 2024):''' [[Jonny Chu|Jonathan Chu]] vs. [[Patrick Lima]]
